_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Gemini CLI user-level hooks. Prefer plugins/gemini/install.sh, which renders verified absolute runtime paths. Project-source hooks may be gated by the harness trust setting and are not a substitute for user-level installation.
_paths_note: Replace @HESTIA_HOME@ (the deploying environment's HESTIA_HOME, absolute; deploy/register-members.py refuses when it is unset), @HESTIA_DEFAULT_ROLE@ (install.default_role, inside a HESTIA_ROLE pass-through; dropped when undeclared), @HESTIA_WORKSPACE@ and @HESTIA_PLUGIN_ROOT@ before installation, then verify every command target exists. Unrendered placeholders must never be installed: a missing hook process may fail open in the harness.
_hooksConfig_note: Pin "hooksConfig": {"enabled": true} in settings.json alongside this block. It defaults true, but "enabled": false disarms every hook and hooksConfig.disabled can disable this gate by command string. Operator's prerogative, but it must be visible to anything auditing the member.
_timeout_contract: One-gate stage C. The BeforeTool gate READS its timeout from the registration this template becomes (MILLISECONDS; gemini-cli's default for an entry without one is 60000) and decides inside start + timeout - 1.5 s, so it always fails closed before gemini-cli kills it (a timed-out hook produces no output and the tool proceeds, i.e. fail-open). 15000 ms absorbs a cold member connect (measured 4.6-5.1 s). A shorter registration costs availability, never safety; deploy/register-members.py reports one below this floor.
